modelEvidenceCorrections: The model used June 23, 2019 as the opening/completion milestone. Infrastructure Ontario's current project page gives February 19, 2019 as the construction-end date, so the canonical milestone uses that exact official date.

The model described Axium Infrastructure Canada II L.P. as both fund and vehicle. The direct release proves it is an equity sponsor, but the current curated database has no matching Fund row. The proposal preserves the disclosed name as the vehicle and does not create an unsupported fund relationship.

The model relied on current pages for ongoing status. William Osler's audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026 independently confirm that Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership remains responsible for operating and maintaining the building and that the assets transfer in July 2048.

The model included the 2024 CVC DIF manager rebrand as a company milestone. The final company timeline omits it because it was a manager-level transaction, while the ownership rationale and source set preserve the alias lineage without mischaracterizing it as a project sale.

The first proposal attempt omitted the retired duplicate's June 28, 2016 Ontario funding milestone. The production dry-run rejected that incomplete merge before any write. Proposal v2 preserves the milestone and binds it to the official Ontario release.
A legacy Infrastructure Ontario value-for-money PDF URL returned HTTP 404 and is excluded from the proposal. The live project page and contract-award page supply the controlling official facts.
exitSearchConclusion: No project-level sponsor sale, equity transfer, signed pending exit or concession termination was identified through 2026-08-18. Current Infrastructure Ontario, Axium, William Osler and Equans evidence continues to show an operational availability-based PPP. CVC's 2024 acquisition of the DIF manager was not an Etobicoke Healthcare Partnership equity sale.
